notes.title: Virtual Driving School: VR & Steering Wheel Patch
notes.content:
Following up from recent user reports of issues with the VR and steering wheel support, our latest patch should help fix these issues, (Along with some other background tweaks )

If you have any more problems, make sure to let us know!
Or if there's anything else you'd like to ask, get in contact through our steam community, or with our:
